title: Mobile: the ☰ is the page nav again, plus an ✦ AI that answers from the phone

set.request: Mobile: the ☰ gives the page's own nav back; a bottom rail with an ✦ AI button and a listening sheet; honest mic errors; Dictate variants. Owner's words: /framework/ai/2026/09/29/mobile-nav-back-an-ai-rail-at-the-bottom/owner-words.md

Dictate variants linked from the playground
